Just Finished Ryukendo.

Really Solid Show.

Premise wise it's nothing new and it's light on story, but it handles the basic elements extremely well in executions. 

It sits next to Guyferd and the Choseishin shows in other toku shows, that it makes me wish we saw more like it. https://t.co/twitter_link

The villains were also pretty good, and worked just as well in other shows like it. 

Jack Moon was the best and a high light of the show whenever he had an episode dedicated to him.

The show combines the best elements of Modern Toku but also older, it's a good balance between the two and knows when to go big and when to keep things grounded.

There's some pretty cool shit in ryukendo, that I hardly see in shows like this, like Air battles.

I felt it's 3 leads were all very well rounded and balanced, Each of them had really great development throughout the course of the series that I liked them all of them. 

Character development is what this show does really well.

It's just a really solid all around show that really has nothing wrong with it and that's actually nice to see. 

I'm glad I got to experience it.

The music is also really good too. I didn't think Michiru Oshima would be involved in this but I feel this has her best work that I've heard her from.

Plus the openings and the ed songs are really good, esp the kitadani one.
It also has a pretty good sense of humor too, I usually don't care for a lot of comedic attempts in any Toku show but ryukendo does it pretty well without actually breaking the flow of things.
